newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian Rayon up 7.4 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Indian Rayon up 7.4 pct on results.

text.p: Shares of Indian Rayon jumped 26.50 rupees, or 7.4 percent, to 386.75 at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Friday after the firm posted a 16 percent rise in net profit for financial year 1996/97, traders said.
The share crossed its 52-week high of 377.0 rupees after the firm announced its results.
More than 36,000 shares changed hands in afternoon trade at the Bombay exchange.

The company said on Friday that its net profit rose to 2.15 billion rupees against 1.85 billion in the corresponding period a year ago. Indian Rayon's net sales jumped 16 percent to 14.12 billion rupees from 12.08 billion earlier.
